metadata.kort:about: Depth layers only, sizes for the screen (96 dpi). In a base map: the 'sea' layers go right after the sea polygon, the 'lake' layers after the lake fills, the labels below the place names (see withDepth in style.mjs). For print, regenerate with depthLayers(id, { variant, pxPerMm: dpi / 25.4 }).
